cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Back My Version
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to remember, repeat, and defend one shared version of events when questions begin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The baker's asking about the cake we ate. We were checking the filling. Remember how I trained you to describe a tasting?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You said it was spare, not a sample.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you noticed the lemon was sharp. Good palate. Tell her we were checking the balance; I'll say the same.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you say you gave me the first slice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, my suggestion, your tasting notes. Start with the sharp lemon. Let's hear how you'll tell her we both checked it.

reason: Tie an actual remembered teaching habit to the current pursuit, clarify inquiry stakes where absent, and give each partner contribution a consequential response. Differentiate adjacent cover-story scenes rather than repeat cupboard staging.
